page.overview:
What is Evil Black Drum Kingdom?

The Evil Black Drum Kingdom is the kingdom Wapol currently rules with his wife Kinderella and his dog Hakowan by his side.

Virtually nothing is known about the geography of the Evil Black Drum Kingdom, as it has yet to be explored in-depth. However, it is known to be in the South Blue, with a huge castle and rather stormy weather in the skies.

After Wapol achieved success with his corporation Wapol Konzern, the World Nobles acknowledged him and gave him his own kingdom. This made him once again eligible to attend the Levely.

As the time for the Levely drew near, the rulers and several guards prepared to head to Mary Geoise. Wapol was somewhat excited to see the Sakura Kingdom under Dalton's rule, and showed his desire in destroying it.
